_doc: OpenRouter model chains per Hermes profile. Failover script promotes next model on 404/delist. Ops pool = OPENROUTER_API_KEY_OPS; RP = OPENROUTER_API_KEY_RP. Do NOT re-add tencent/hy3:free (OpenRouter sunset 2026-07-21).

providers._doc: Chain entries default to OpenRouter. To route an entry via ZenMux, prefix its slug with `zenmux:` (e.g. `zenmux:openai/gpt-5`); the dashboard maps that to `hermes --provider zenmux -m <slug>` and Hermes resolves providers.zenmux from profile config.yaml (key_env ZENMUX_API_KEY). Default chains below are unprefixed = OpenRouter (unchanged).
